ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment Districts and indications as shown on Map
No. 20-B in the area bound by:

East 79" Street; South Commercial Avenue; a line 239.08 feet south of and parallel to
East 79" Street; and, the South Chicago Railroad Branch of Illinois Central Railroad
right-of-way

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
